shared_elements: a ring or circular motif (concentric disc in A; ring-shaped element in B)
justification: A depicts a narrative scene of schematic stick-limbed human figures with concentric-disc shields, a horn-blower and multi-crewed boats, whereas B is an architectural setting of upright pillars around a rectangular basin-like installation with a ring element, showing only a faint incised animal on one pillar. Apart from the coincidental presence of a ring/disc shape, there is no shared figural subject, relationship or compositional logic.
